name: Rain maker (real books)
description: Rests a post-only offer of YES (= sells NO-side exposure; no maker fee on weather) at the best ask on KXRAIN city-days in the last 6 h before the close when the YES bid is 10-90c, up to 40 contracts short per market, held to settlement. Retail buys the YES lottery ticket (rain-no found YES takers lose 7-17c/ct); a maker collects the ask instead of paying the bid.
hypothesis: rain-no (taker, trade-synthesized book) earns +14.1c dev / +4.5c lockbox. On the REAL recorded books for the same dev days (Jul 16-Aug 31, ad hoc engine runs, fixed 10 contracts) the taker rule nets +9.6c/ct (CI +4.5..+14.2, 210 mkts, 42 days) and a post-only offer at the touch nets +16.75c/ct (CI +8.5..+23.1, 181 mkts, 6,298 contracts, 37/42 days, Jul +29.9 Aug +13.0). Counterparty: retail buying YES at the ask on a forecast PoP. Wrong if the walk-forward CI (pooled, city-day clusters) <= 0, the 2x-latency run loses, or the Sep 1+ lockbox loses (autumn frontal rain, informed YES buyers once rain has started).
next: Passed the lockbox (weak): +5.84c/ct, CI -0.26..+12.01, 139 mkts (dev full +16.78c, CI +9.8..+23.3). Recorded books Oct 13-16: -7.1c on 17 mkts. Next: user decides paper; paper on KXRAIN recorded books checks the queue fills at the ask; audit before live.
